name: app_creator_app
label: SDK
subtitle: Describe and create a SciTeX app workspace
about: Create and validate leaf applications with the shared SciTeX SDK appmaker. Each application owns its Django GUI and runs standalone or as a Hub plugin.
description: Create an app workspace from the user's description with the SDK appmaker, then validate, dev-install or submit through the existing SDK tools. The description is saved as the agent's implementation brief; creating the workspace does not implement the requested feature. Served by scitex-sdk gui serve or mounted by a host.
author: scitex-ai
capabilities: Create a plain app workspace and preserve the user's implementation brief
Validate a scaffolded app and show errors plus advisory notices
Dev-install an app to a SciTeX Cloud server for immediate testing
Submit an app for review and publication

scope_capability_reasons.project: The app wizard uses an explicit target directory; project-scoped operations are not implemented.
